_note: PS/2 keyboard interface peripheral. 8-bit parallel data bus (d0-d7) + data-available strobe (da). Machine-side device: the board part holds a PS2Keyboard whose keyDown/keyUp queue scan codes. Protocol delivery (paced frames, DA strobe, odd parity) runs on the machine side through PS2Capture + ps2OnVia. Terminals exist for the designer's wiring display — actual data flows through the machine adapter, not the MNA. Wires to VIA PA0-PA7 or PB0-PB7, DA to CA1/CA2/CB1/CB2. Engine source: ps2-device.js.
